concerns.text: Tasks T504, T505, T506, T507, and T508 implement features (conformer ensembles, hydration modeling, physics-informed loss, stereoisomer breakdown, physical descriptor correlation) that are explicitly declared 'out-of-scope' in spec.md Assumptions and FR-011. These tasks have no matching FR/SC in the spec and violate the project scope, meaning the implementer cannot satisfy the spec by executing them.

Task T019 is marked as incomplete (checkbox unchecked) and generates `data/reports/excluded_molecules.csv`. Spec.md User Story 1 Acceptance Scenario 3 and Edge Cases explicitly require handling missing 3D coordinates and reporting excluded counts. The absence of a completed task to generate this artifact means the spec requirement is unfulfilled.

Task T034 cites an external arXiv URL (0804.4361) to justify metrics format. While the task exists, the spec.md and plan.md require 'Verified Accuracy' (Constitution Principle II) and forbid unverified URLs in artifacts. The task description itself contains an unverified citation, creating a conflict where the task cannot be completed without violating the Constitution, effectively blocking the FR-012/SC-001 requirement for valid metrics reporting.

Tasks T402-T405 reference scripts (`download_data.py`, `train.py`, etc.) that the plan.md 'Project Structure' section explicitly defines as existing files. The tasks are framed as 'Reconcile run-book vs implementation' implying the files are missing, but the plan asserts they exist. This creates a stale tag/contradiction where the task logic (fix missing file) conflicts with the plan's definition of the artifact state.
